source: Shift-crew hookup table 'After 13/08 (Thu entry - beam studies - Jared + Halen) GOOD FOR RUNS 3061-3063'. Supersedes HallD-BIC-09-15-2026.pdf wherever they differ: the boards were re-hooked on 8/13, so slide 13 (KCU1 ASIC labels) and slide 19 (paddle channels) describe the earlier hookup.
setup: August week 2: SFIL1-4 on passive summing boards, both ends on KCU0; SFIL5 on individual-SiPM boards on KCU1, only the South end alive

kcu0.asic0: SFIL 1-4 South, passive summing boards, ch 0-71
kcu0.asic2: SFIL 1-4 North, passive summing boards, ch 144-215
kcu0.asic3: Baby BCAL North, BBS01-40 on J1-J40, ch 216-287
kcu0.board_note: ASIC2+ASIC3 are on the HGCROC board swapped in from KCU1 on the night of 8/8-8/9 ('it magically started working')
kcu0.sfil_grid_layout: [row][SFIL layer], row r = hookup cell r+1. Per B. Kim SiPM deck 10/8 update (ANL LED bench test): on v2 SiPM boards cells 1 and 2 both read SiPM1+SiPM2 mixed; cell 3 = SiPM3 (beam row); cell 4 = SiPM4. v2 boards = all South SFIL1-4 and North SFIL2-4; North SFIL1 is v1 (one-to-one). Run 3062: r(cell1,cell2)=0.97-0.99 on v2, 0.20 on v1.

paddle_connectors.5: J17 (table says J5, but J5 is ch 93; data and edge-board table say ch 81 = J17)

notes: Hookup table confirms the slide-24 values 43/37 (not slide 18's 42/38) and the full South and North grids channel for channel.

SFIL4 South cells 1 and 2 are on edge-board connectors J63/J64; every other South channel is on J1-J16. On North only cell 1 is on J63, cell 2 moved to J13. That asymmetry, not a mapping error, explains slide 24's 'those two look smaller on South wrt North'.
Slide 24's suggested ch150/ch165 swap is NOT in the hookup table: 150 = SFIL1 cell 2 North, 165 = SFIL2 cell 1 North, as mapped here.
Slide 19's paddle channels (82/86/93/97) are the pre-8/13 hookup. Run 3062 data: 84/86/81/97 fire at 43-59%, 82 and 93 are quiet.

Baby BCAL North gave nothing in run 3062: ch252-287 railed at ADC 1023, ch216-251 clean pedestal but zero channels above 20 ADC. Matches slide 16 'Baby BCAL - Noise only -> Added CAEN on South Side'. Use the CAEN stream for Baby BCAL.

kcu1.asic2: SFIL5 South, individual SiPMs on Samtec, NO light guides and no cookies, ch 144-215. The only live half of KCU1.
kcu1.asic0: SFIL5 North, individual SiPMs, LGs + cookies, ch 0-71
kcu1.board_note: ASIC0/ASIC1 are the HGCROC board that came off KCU0. The hookup table already says it 'is not working well'; run 3062 confirms it.
notes: 'Half of SFIL 5' in the run log = the South end only, because the North board was dead. It is not a transverse half.

No per-SiPM channel numbers exist for SFIL5. In run 3062, 53 channels respond, spanning ch154-214. Each 36-channel group splits into a quieter lower part and a hotter upper part (ch154-160 / ch180-196 at 17-28% hit rate, ch162-178 / ch198-214 at 33-59%), consistent with two 16-SiPM cells per group.

Which SFIL5 cell is which is NOT established. Correlating each KCU1 channel against the KCU0 cells over 16198 matched pairs cannot separate them: with a single-row beam the dominant variation is total shower energy, so every live KCU1 channel picks SFIL3 cell 3 as its best partner (r = 0.20-0.58, decoy < 0.03).
SFIL5 North: ch0-35 and ch72-107 are railed at ADC 1023; ch36-71 and ch108-143 pedestal normally at ~80 ADC but only ch47, 54, 60, 65, 66 ever cross 20 ADC.
kcu1.asic2_layout: Individual-SiPM ASIC layout (Olaiya; Kim slide 6/31): array A = 144-151,153-160; B = 162-169,171-178; C = 180-187,189-196; D = 198-205,207-214; 152,161,170,179,188,197,206,215 not connected (= the every-9th gaps seen in run 3062). SFIL5 boards are v1 (no SiPM1+2 mixing).
kcu1.asic2_vertical_order: From run-3062 data (sync/sfil5_map.py), bottom to top in AstroPix y: A < B < D < C. B below D and C above D are firm (AstroPix share profiles and the SFIL3-4 upper-cell fraction agree); A at the bottom is weaker (6/16 live). No height structure is resolved within an array. With the May-board analogy A=SiPM1, B=SiPM2, D=SiPM3, C=SiPM4 the order is monotonic but opposite to SFIL1-4 (SiPM1+2 above SiPM3 there), i.e. the SFIL5 South board is flipped relative to SFIL1-4 if the analogy holds. Not bench-confirmed.

dead_groups_run3062.description: Slide 23's '36-group channels with very high pedestal or not responding', located. Railed = pedestal median 1023 ADC, MAD 0, over 4000 waveforms.

source_notes: Kim run log says 3060-3063 'KCU1 was taken out (no SFIL5)'; run 3062 ROC_1 data contradicts this (53 live SFIL5 South channels, tick-matched to KCU0).
B. Kim 'SiPM info' 2026-09-29, updated 10/8 (SiPM3,4 -> SiPM1,2 correction): KCU config history, edge-board J->channel table, v2 SiPM1/2 mixing.
